Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: Hangul Sori PACKS-family editorial card.
REFERENCE IMAGE ROLE
Use the attached approved C1Access golden-master image ONLY as the exact
visual-family and style swatch. Match its 4:3 canvas, warm full-bleed hanji
field, Korean-modernist background geometry, dot-marker vocabulary, premium
material richness, matte print texture, lighting and visual density. Do not
copy its keys, hourglass, chest or any central object.
PRIMARY REQUEST
Create one completely new PACKS-family card for this subject:
NEW SUBJECT
{INSERT ONE SUBJECT BLOCK HERE}
FORMAT
Horizontal 4:3 composition. Design for final export as 800 x 600 WebP in
sRGB. Fill every edge with warm hanji ivory, approximately #F4E8D0. No inner
white border, frame, margin, canvas shadow or transparency.
BACKGROUND SYSTEM
Preserve the established family shell:
- brick red #B94B32 plane entering from the upper-right edge;
- second restrained brick-red plane touching the lower-left edge;
- muted teal #5F9A93 plane entering from the lower-right edge;
- broad ochre-gold and ivory diagonal planes near the lower center;
- upper-left vertical row of four dots in red, gold, teal and teal, plus a
  small gold dot grid;
- smaller mirrored red-gold-teal dot grouping at mid-right.
Background geometry stays subordinate and never becomes a frame.
SUBJECT COMPOSITION
Build one compact, coherent central still-life mass. Use one dominant anchor
object with two or three supporting objects unless the subject logically needs
fewer. For still lifes, occupy about 38 to 55 percent of canvas width. Center
the group slightly below the vertical midpoint. Keep all important objects and
their shadow between 12 and 88 percent of canvas height for the app's 16:10
crop. The concept must remain unmistakable at 100 pixels.
STYLE
Create a refined Korean-modernist editorial still life with smooth controlled
silhouettes, rounded semi-realistic 2.5D volume and selective planar colour
breaks. The result must look richer and more premium than a flat vector card.
Show restrained material evidence such as warm wood grain, aged brass patina,
soft glass highlights, ceramic glaze, paper layering, cloth weave or stone
porosity when relevant. Keep the hierarchy clean and never drift into
photorealism or glossy CGI.
TEXTURE
Apply fine dry-print grain, matte paper tooth and subtle ink speckling across
the entire image, including background, objects and shadows. Add slight ink
pooling along selected shape boundaries without creating drawn outlines. The
texture is visible at 100 percent zoom but reads as clean colour at thumbnail
size. No coarse grunge, scratches, watercolor blooms or oversized fibres.
LIGHT AND SHADOW
Soft upper-left light, warm-neutral colour, restrained contrast. Use one short,
soft, matte grounding shadow. No dramatic rim light, deep cinematic darkness,
floating objects or long hard cast shadows.
PALETTE
#F4E8D0 #FAF6EC #FFFCF2 #8E6646 #5C4028 #2A3340 #DFA951 #B94B32
#5F9A93 #8B8478. Add at most two muted subject-specific colours. Metals are
aged, never mirror-bright. Wood remains warm brown, never near-black.
STRICTLY FORBIDDEN
No people, hands, animals, insects, mascots, writing, letters, numbers,
calligraphy, logos, watermarks, speech bubbles, decorative text, character
seals, glossy 3D, photorealism, thick uniform black outlines, full-surface
low-poly faceting, internal smooth gradients, sepia wash, sparse line art,
white inset frames, unnecessary props or unrelated decoration. Every book,
document, plaque, ruler, seal and screen must remain completely blank.
OUTPUT
Return exactly one polished opaque 4:3 image. Do not add explanatory text.
